turns.npc_dialogue: Well, well. Look who wandered into my saloon. State your business, stranger.

player_options.label: Introduce
player_options.text: Just here to talk business, Sal. Nothing more.

player_options.label: Size him up
player_options.text: I hear you've got something worth my while.

player_options.label: Get to it
player_options.text: Cut the theatrics. Let's talk price.

player_options.label: Play dumb
player_options.text: Oh, I was just passing through, really.

turns.npc_dialogue: Heh. Bold for a stranger. Fine — I'm listening. What've you got to offer, exactly?

player_options.label: Show watch
player_options.text: This pocket watch. Family heirloom, runs like new.

player_options.label: Lowball
player_options.text: Depends what you're willing to give up first.

player_options.label: Demand
player_options.text: That six-shooter. That's what I'm here for.

player_options.label: Bluff
player_options.text: Let's just say it's worth more than it looks.

turns.npc_dialogue: A watch? That's what you're wasting my time with? I've seen better in a pawn shop bin.

player_options.label: Reassure
player_options.text: It's worth more than it looks, I promise you that.

player_options.label: Sweeten
player_options.text: I'll throw in something extra if that six-shooter's on the table.

player_options.label: Push
player_options.text: Take it or leave it, Sal. My patience runs thin too.

player_options.label: Stall
player_options.text: There's more where that came from, trust me.

turns.npc_dialogue: You've got about one more sentence before I show you the door. Make it count.

player_options.label: Apologize
player_options.text: Fair enough. Let's find terms we can both live with.

player_options.label: Final offer
player_options.text: Watch, plus a favor owed. That's my final word.

player_options.label: Snap back
player_options.text: Watch your tone, old man. I'm not scared of you.

player_options.label: Charm
player_options.text: Come on, Sal — you know you like me.

endingAccepted.npc_dialogue: ...Alright. Alright! Deal. Don't make me regret this, stranger.

endingHostile.npc_dialogue: That's IT! Get OUT of my saloon before I throw you out myself!
